name: How to Flatten a PDF
description: Bake form fields permanently into the PDF page — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your filled PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your filled PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Click Flatten PDF
step.text: Press the Flatten PDF button. All interactive elements are merged into the static page content in your browser.

step.name: Download the locked PDF
step.text: Your flattened PDF downloads immediately. Fields are now permanent — the document cannot be edited by any recipient.
